items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Speaking Spanish comes in handy. Yeah. It was what helped Alvarez too when he was on the wrong spot speaking Spanish, you know.

ctx.x: I don't know. I imagine maybe in the years before I blew my mind.
He's like Alvarez and all that family. He speaks Spanish.
